title: Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
abstract: arXiv:2611.20306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflic

translated_title: 面向异构机器人团队的本体编译控制障碍函数
translated_abstract: 异构机器人团队的安全过滤器常常因为约束缺失、制动能力被高估以及各自可满足的约束之间发生冲突而失效。我们提出OntoCBF，它将一个包含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理以及每类机器人动力学特征信息的领域本体，编译为一个控制障碍函数（CBF）安全过滤器，其中每个智能体对应求解一个二次规划。描述逻辑推理可在线为任意团队生成约束，包括那些由关系链条以及由机器人所携带载荷定义的类所推出的约束，因此现有的安全公理能够覆盖新的机器人类、载荷类及其组合。我们证明，只要一个子类能够产生其父类的全部速度，它就可以复用父类的制动能力，这一性质独立于子类包含关系（subsumption）。对于箱式约束的双积分器，该性质也是必要的，且此时每一次安全性丧失都始于一个冲突（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出OntoCBF方法，将领域本体（含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理和动力学特征）编译为控制障碍函数安全过滤器，借助描述逻辑在线推理生成约束，并证明子类在能产生父类全部速度时可复用父类制动能力，从而解决异构机器人团队安全过滤中约束缺失、制动能力高估与约束冲突的问题。
en_tdlr: OntoCBF compiles a domain ontology into per-agent control barrier function safety filters with online description-logic constraint entailment and proves that subclasses producing all parent velocities can reuse parental braking capability, addressing missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities, and constraint conflicts in heterogeneous robot teams.
